Manu Bhaker misses medal, recalls mentor Jaspal Rana at Asian Games

Indian shooter Manu Bhaker missed out on a medal in the 10m air pistol event at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games. This was her first competitive outing since the passing of her mentor, Jaspal Rana. Bhaker reportedly felt overwhelmed by memories of Rana during the competition.
